llm_response.reason: The website claims to sell Caterpillar brand shoes at highly discounted prices (up to 50% off) well below usual Swiss retail, uses urgency tactics like fast delivery/discounts/free shipping, and lacks all required credible company details (no valid Impressum, Kontakt, or business registration). The domain was registered recently and is privacy-protected in Malaysia, making the Swiss business claim not credible. These all fit the profile of a fake online shop designed to scam buyers out of money.
